name: umd
description: UMD campus events on a Google calendar of their own: TerpLink and CS department feeds, calendar.umd.edu, STAMP and Careers, with a model deciding once per event whether it belongs, by your own criteria.

setup.prompt: The name of the Google calendar campus events should go on. Create it first; Herald manages everything on it

Which campus events do you want on that calendar, and which should be left off? Plain sentences, as specific as you like (for example: tech talks, free food, concerts and big parties yes; religious services, recurring club meetings and anything for grad students no)
Your UMD email, sent with every scrape so a campus webmaster can contact you instead of blocking you
How many days ahead to keep events on the calendar
Which model judges the events (blank for your usual one)

steps: Create a Google calendar with the name you chose (Google Calendar > Settings > Add calendar > Create new calendar). Herald writes to it and nothing else; you can hide it when you only want your own events.
Install the scrapers' packages into Herald's venv: ~/herald/venv/bin/pip install beautifulsoup4 lxml
If your criteria are long, they can live in your ledger instead: a section headed "## Campus events calendar review" in identity/preferences.md is read in place of umd.review_criteria.

Turn it on with herald ext enable umd, then herald services install for the review timer. The first scrape takes about a minute; the first review runs within six hours, or now with herald cycle campus_review.

provides_capabilities.title: UMD campus events
provides_capabilities.summary: Every event the university publishes, judged by your criteria, on a calendar of its own.
